references.text: Joshua had previously chosen twelve men, one from each tribe, in preparation for this moment
Moses also called twelve representatives, one from each tribe, in connection with the covenant ceremony
Twelve men, one from each tribe, were selected to help Moses with the census
Twelve spies, one from each tribe, were sent out to explore the land of Canaan
The immediate context where God commands Joshua to choose twelve men to take stones from the Jordan
Elijah built an altar with twelve stones, one for each of the tribes of Israel, serving as a reminder of the twelve tribes
